analogy.rationale: Omega-3 fatty acids act largely through FFAR1/FFAR4 (GPR40/GPR120) and are metabolized by COX-2 (PTGS2) and CYP450/LOX pathways, so PPAR agonists, FAAH inhibitors, and COX inhibitors share downstream lipid-signaling programs; TRPV1 modulation is a minor shared target. Overall transcriptional impact in these cell lines is expected to be weak because the receptors are expressed at low levels and the response is largely metabolic.
